verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS directory and device-management platform that ships endpoint agents, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. The Directory Insights event logging is a customer-facing audit feature, not vendor telemetry, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
